# Issuance Row

Figma: [08u. Issuance Row](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=4050-135215) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

A status-grouped row for an investor’s issuances: a coloured status icon + status name + investment count, with the total amount (SAR ﷼) and a chevron. Tap to expand (Open) into the individual investments, or See all. Built atom (Status Icon) → molecule (Issuance Row) → organism (Issuance List). English + Arabic (RTL).

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/issuance-row/reference.png`

### Issuance Row

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Investors hold issuances in many states (defaulted, late, matured, active…). This row groups them by status so the portfolio reads at a glance, with the amount trailing and an expandable list of the underlying investments.

### Atomic architecture

- Status Icon (atom) - the 9 coloured status SVGs (from the source example), one component set with a Status variant.
- Issuance Row (molecule) - the row: State (Default/Focus/Open) × Language (English/Arabic); props Status · Count · Amount · Status Icon (swap).
- Issuance List (organism) - a stack of rows, one per status; any row can be Open (expanded).

### Anatomy

- Status Icon - 32px, colour-coded per status (instance-swap slot).
- Status + Count - status name over the investment count.
- Amount - the total, with the SAR ﷼ glyph.
- Chevron - down when collapsed, up when Open.

### Statuses

Nine statuses, each with its own colour + icon. Swap the Status Icon and set the Status text to switch.

Defaulted

Partially Repaid

Late

Repayment Due

Matured

Active

Funded

Raising

Reserved

### States

- Default - collapsed row.
- Focus - selected/pressed; a subtle bg/disabled highlight.
- Open - expanded: header + the underlying investments (each with amount + maturity) + a “See all investments” button.

### Direction - English & Arabic (RTL)

RTL is primary. In Arabic the row mirrors: the status icon leads on the right, the status/count read right-aligned, and the amount + chevron move to the left.

> **Warning:** The Arabic variants use IBM Plex Sans Arabic, which can’t be loaded in-plugin - so they can’t be re-instanced or shown live here. They render live inside the component set on the 08u page (Language = Arabic). Don’t replace them with an image.

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Expand in place to reveal the underlying investments; keep the same header visible.

Don’t

Don’t recolour the status label or amount per status - only the icon carries the status colour.
